evidence.detail: Update active_date in cache when we insert a match — changed update_cache signature to accept active_date/dt and pass dtutil.dt2ts(dt) instead of keeping the old value

insert_match now calls update_cache(left_id, left_games, right_games, dt=dt) and update_cache(right_id, ..., dt=dt), so active_date is set to the match timestamp for every insert including admin inserts
update_cache: active_date = dtutil.dt2ts(dt) if dt else 'active_date'; when dt is provided (all insert paths), the column is updated
Admin 'add' action calls ms.insert_match(dtutil.now(), ...) which flows through the fixed path

triage.notes: Commit 61521821 cites Fixes #6771 (not #7185), so the issue was likely filed as a separate report of the same underlying bug either concurrently or shortly after; the fix covers all insert_match callers including the admin path. The 160 historical records with wrong active_date would have been corrected by the nightly reprime_cache job. Issue can be closed.
